Subject: Your consumer complaint matter

Dear Mr. Kulkarni,

Thank you for meeting us on 29 September 2022 about your dispute with M/s Skyline Constructions. As we understand it, possession of the flat is long overdue.

Our advice is to claim interest on the amount paid for every month of delay in possession. Please collect the allotment letter, the builder-buyer agreement and every payment receipt and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of INR 2,45,00,000/-.

Regards,
Adv. Hema Lakshmanan
